Usage: agentcage cage grants [OPTIONS] NAME COMMAND [ARGS]...

  Manage Policy API runtime domain grants (see docs/explain/policy-api.md).

Options:
  --help  Show this message and exit.

Commands:
  list     List runtime grants (overlay) and the static baseline for a cage.
  promote  Promote a runtime grant into the permanent baseline, then drop...
  revoke   Remove a runtime grant from the overlay (does not touch the...
  sync     Reconcile decided grants into the operator's cage.yaml baseline.

Aliases:
  ls → list
